sentences.en: And its central charge is that the president incited a violent insurrection against the government of the United States.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And it actually quotes from the president's remarks that day.
sentences.zh: 好吧，在这里。

sentences.en: Nick, do you have the article?
sentences.zh: 这是出自第一条，煽动叛乱。

sentences.en: I wonder if you could read from it.
sentences.zh: 该条款的起草者写道：

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 在联席会议开始前不久，特朗普总统在华盛顿特区的椭圆形草坪向人群发表了讲话。

sentences.en: OK, here it is.
sentences.zh: 在那里，他重申了虚假的主张，即“我们赢得了这场选举，我们以压倒性优势获胜”。

sentences.en: This is from Article 1, Incitement of Insurrection.
sentences.zh: 他还故意发表了这样的言论：在当时的情境下，这些言论鼓励并可预见地导致了国会大厦的违法行为，例如——这是一句引言——“如果你不拼命奋斗，

sentences.en: The drafters of the article write,
sentences.zh: 你们就不会再拥有一个国家了”。

sentences.en: Shortly before the joint session commenced, President Trump addressed a crowd at the Ellipse in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 因此，该条款接着写道：

sentences.en: There he reiterated false claims that, quote, we won this election and we won it by a landslide, unquote.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普总统和他所对峙的人群中成员的煽动下，为了

sentences.en: He also willfully made statements that, in context, encouraged and foreseeably resulted in lawless action at the Capitol, such as, this is a quote, if you don't fight like hell,
sentences.zh: 干扰联席会议履行确认 2020 年总统选举结果的神圣宪法职责等目标，

sentences.en: you're not going to have a country anymore.
sentences.zh: 非法闯入并破坏国会大厦，伤害和杀害执法人员，

sentences.en: Thus, the article continues,
sentences.zh: 威胁国会议员、副总统和国会工作人员，并参与其他暴力、致命、破坏性和煽动性的行为。

sentences.en: Incited by President Trump and members of the crowd he addressed in an attempt to, among other
sentences.zh: 你知道，过去的弹劾，我的意思是，甚至在一年前他们弹劾特朗普总统时，都是一个相当错综复杂的程序和论点。

sentences.en: objectives, interfere with the joint session's solemn constitutional duty to certify the results of the
sentences.zh: 收集访谈和证据花了几个月的时间。

sentences.en: 2020 presidential election, unlawfully breached and vandalized the Capitol, injured and killed law
sentences.zh: 当时的案情甚至还有点抽象。

sentences.en: enforcement personnel, menaced members of Congress, the vice president and congressional personnel, and engaged in other violent, deadly, destructive and seditious acts.
sentences.zh: 而在这里，它是非常清晰和非常简单的。

sentences.en: You know, impeachment in the past, I mean, even a year ago when they were impeaching President Trump, was a fairly convoluted process and argument.
sentences.zh: 总统创造了这次事件发生的理由，然后他唆使了随之而来的暴力。

sentences.en: It took months to put together interviews and evidence.
sentences.zh: 为此，他必须被弹劾、定罪、罢免，并不准再次担任公职。

sentences.en: And the case even was somewhat abstracted.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here it's very plain and it's very simple.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The president created the reason for this event to be happening and then he instigated the violence that would follow.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: And for that, he needs to be impeached, convicted, removed from office and not allowed to hold office again.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，而且不需要绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，即可获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So what will the process of bringing this article, bringing this case, actually look like in the House of Representatives?
sentences.zh: 那么，在众议院推进这篇弹劾条款、推进这个案件的实际流程会是怎样的呢？

sentences.en: Will it at all resemble the last impeachment, which, Nick, we talked about with you because you covered it?
sentences.zh: 它会和上次弹劾有任何相似之处吗，尼克？我们曾向你请教过，因为你当时报道了那场弹劾。

sentences.en: It was very elaborate.
sentences.zh: 那次非常详尽。

sentences.en: There were hearings.
sentences.zh: 有听证会。

sentences.en: There was testimony.
sentences.zh: 有证词。

sentences.en: It's hard to picture all that happening in the span of just a few days.
sentences.zh: 很难想象所有这些事情能在短短几天内发生。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And the truth is, most of it won't happen.
sentences.zh: 事实是，大部分都不会发生。

sentences.en: You know, unlike then where we got used to this kind of slow drip of information and a crescendo of public hearings with different people involved,
sentences.zh: 你知道，不像上次那样，我们习惯了这种缓慢的信息滴漏，以及形形色色的人参与其中、高潮迭起的公开听证会，

sentences.en: the House is prepared to move starting Wednesday morning to directly impeach the president without any of that.
sentences.zh: 众议院准备从周三上午开始行动，在没有任何这些流程的情况下直接弹劾总统。

sentences.en: So there will be a debate on the floor of the House where Republicans and Democrats will have a chance to say their piece.
sentences.zh: 因此，众议院大厅将会有一场辩论，共和党人和民主党人将有机会发表他们的看法。

sentences.en: And then, assuming that Pence doesn't act or Trump doesn't resign, which no one thinks is likely, there will be an up or down vote on this article of impeachment.
sentences.zh: 然后，假设彭斯不采取行动或者特朗普不辞职——没有人认为这有可能发生，将对这篇弹劾条款进行表决。

sentences.en: I wonder if you think that the first impeachment in any way paved the way for this version.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你是否认为第一次弹劾在任何程度上为这次铺平了道路。

sentences.en: Is it only possible, I guess I'm saying, to pursue this kind of rapid-fire impeachment after having carried out a much longer, more formal version against the same president?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，只有在对同一位总统进行了更长时间、更正式的弹劾之后，才有可能进行这种闪电式的弹劾吗？

sentences.en: I've been thinking about this a whole lot over the last several days, in part because I'm kind of cycling through my own memories of covering that last one
sentences.zh: 过去几天我一直在深入思考这个问题，部分原因是我正在脑海中不断回放自己报道上一次弹劾时的记忆，

sentences.en: and talking to a lot of the same lawmakers and their advisors and lawyers who drew up that process.
sentences.zh: 并且与许多制定了那一程序的同一批议员、他们的顾问以及律师进行了交谈。

sentences.en: And there's definitely a sense or an accumulated expertise that I think is making this possible.
sentences.zh: 而且确实有一种经验或积累下来的专业知识，我认为正是这一点让这一切成为可能。

sentences.en: I'm not sure if they hadn't impeached him back then, if they'd be able to move as quickly as they are,
sentences.zh: 我不敢确定，如果他们当年没有弹劾他，他们是否还能像现在这样迅速采取行动，

sentences.en: because they kind of know, you know, impeachments happen so rarely in American history that it kind of has to be relearned almost every time by the people involved.
sentences.zh: 因为他们多少知道，你知道的，弹劾在美国历史上太罕见了，几乎每次都需要相关人员重新学习。

sentences.en: But this is the rare case where they know what they're doing.
sentences.zh: 但这次是个罕见的例外，他们知道自己在做什么。

sentences.en: You know, they know where all the doors and cupboards are.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们知道所有的门和壁橱在哪里。

sentences.en: I think the other thing that is different, though, that is guiding this whole process
sentences.zh: 不过，我认为另一个有所不同并指引着整个进程的因素，

sentences.en: is the awareness that the president only has so little time left in office that he's going to be leaving one way or another.
sentences.zh: 是大家意识到总统在任时间已经不多了，无论如何他都要离职了。

sentences.en: So, you know, though they wouldn't readily admit it, it kind of changes the burdens of the process.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，尽管他们可能不会轻易承认，但这在某种程度上改变了程序的负担。

sentences.en: But I think everybody understands that they can move with less deliberateness, perhaps, than they would have under different circumstances if this was, say, six months ago.
sentences.zh: 但我认为每个人都明白，与换作其他情况下——比如如果是六个月前——相比，他们可以不用那么审慎地推进。

sentences.en: So, Nick, correct me if I'm wrong, we expect impeachment to pass the House, which just requires a simple majority vote, and Democrats control the House.
sentences.zh: 那么，尼克，如果我错了请纠正我，我们预计弹劾案将在众议院获得通过，这只需要简单多数票，而民主党人控制了众议院。

sentences.en: And then under normal circumstances, that would prompt a Senate trial that would begin pretty much immediately after the House takes its action.
sentences.zh: 然后在正常情况下，这将引发一场参议院审判，该审判将在众议院采取行动后几乎立即开始。

sentences.en: But that has not necessarily been the plan, according to Democrats.
sentences.zh: 但据民主党人透露，这不一定是既定计划。

sentences.en: So tell us about the thinking there.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲这背后的考量吧。

sentences.en: Well, actually, Michael, the thinking on this seems to be evolving pretty quickly and now seems to be tending back towards a speedy trial.
sentences.zh: 嗯，实际上，迈克尔，对此的考量似乎正在快速演变，现在似乎又倾向于进行一场迅捷的审判。

sentences.en: But the issue of when to try this case is a tricky one because we've been talking so much about the end of President Trump's term,
sentences.zh: 但何时审理此案是个棘手的问题，因为我们一直在谈论特朗普总统任期的结束，

sentences.en: but this is also going to be the beginning of Joe Biden's term, the incoming president.
sentences.zh: 但这也将是当选总统乔·拜登任期的开始。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He has a cabinet he wants to fill.
sentences.zh: 他有想要任命的内阁成员。

sentences.en: He wants to pass legislation addressing the coronavirus crisis.
sentences.zh: 他想要通过应对新冠病毒危机的立法。

sentences.en: And an all-consuming impeachment trial of the last president stomps all over that, not to mention Biden's kind of overarching political message,
sentences.zh: 而一场耗费精力的前总统弹劾审判会打乱这一切，更不用说拜登那种试图将国家凝聚在一起的总体政治信息了。

sentences.en: which is trying to draw the country together.
sentences.zh: 试图将国家凝聚在一起。

sentences.en: So there's been a kind of intense debate playing out among Democrats behind the scenes of, like, how do we get around this?
sentences.zh: 因此，民主党人内部一直在幕后展开激烈的辩论，比如：我们该如何绕过这个难题？

sentences.en: Could we impeach him and never have a trial at all, never send the charges over?
sentences.zh: 我们能不能弹劾他却根本不进行审判，永远不把指控提交过去？

sentences.en: Could we, as one of Biden's allies, Jim Clyburn, the number three House Democrat, was suggesting?
sentences.zh: 正如拜登的盟友之一、众议院民主党三号人物吉姆·克莱伯恩所建议的那样，我们能这样做吗？

sentences.en: Let's give President-elect Biden the 100 days he needs to get his agenda off and running.
sentences.zh: 让我们给当选总统拜登100天的时间来开展并推进他的议程。

sentences.en: And maybe we'll send the articles sometime after that.
sentences.zh: 也许我们在那之后某个时间再提交弹劾条款。

sentences.en: Wait 100 days, let Biden clear the decks, and then we go to trial.
sentences.zh: 等待100天，让拜登扫清障碍，然后我们再去审判。

sentences.en: But the thinking now seems to be to go quickly to trial, and President-elect Biden himself seems to have reconciled himself to that happening.
sentences.zh: 但现在的想法似乎是迅速进入审判，当选总统拜登本人似乎也已经接受了这一点。

sentences.en: My priority is to get, first of all, a stimulus bill passed, and secondly, begin to rebuild the economy.
sentences.zh: 我的首要任务是首先通过一项经济刺激法案，其次是开始重建经济。

sentences.en: And is now arguing maybe we could split the days in half.
sentences.zh: 现在有人提出，也许我们可以把时间对半平分。

sentences.en: So half the day we work on my agenda, we work on confirming my cabinet nominees, and half the day we hold the trial, but we get on with it.
sentences.zh: 因此，半天时间我们致力于我的议程，致力于确认我的内阁提名人选，半天时间我们进行审判，但我们要继续推进。

sentences.en: I think we're headed in that direction because Democrats feel that they can't legitimately argue to the country that this is so urgent that they have to act in six or seven days,
sentences.zh: 我认为我们正朝着这个方向发展，因为民主党人觉得，他们无法在逻辑上向全国论证这事是如此紧急以至于必须在六七天内采取行动，

sentences.en: and then say, oh, wait, but actually we'll wait 100 more days to put on a trial now.
sentences.zh: 然后又说，哦，等等，但实际上现在我们要再等100天才来进行审判。

sentences.en: That's just too difficult a case to make.
sentences.zh: 这个观点实在是太难自圆其说了。

sentences.en: Regardless of timing, Nick, is the goal to ultimately get the Senate through a trial, to convict Trump for inciting a mob?
sentences.zh: 不管时间如何，尼克，最终的目标是让参议院通过审判来判定特朗普煽动暴徒罪名成立吗？

sentences.en: Because whereas the House only needs a majority of votes, the Senate requires two-thirds majority, and even with Democrats winning those two races in Georgia,
sentences.zh: 因为尽管众议院只需要多数票，但参议院需要三分之二多数，即便民主党人赢得了佐治亚州的这两场竞选，

sentences.en: it does not have two-thirds control of the Senate.
sentences.zh: 它也没有获得对参议院的三分之二控制权。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Winning control in Georgia is significant.
sentences.zh: 赢得佐治亚州的控制权意义重大。

sentences.en: It might help give Democrats the ability to set the rules of a Senate trial, but the Constitution sets a very high bar for conviction and potential removal from office.
sentences.zh: 它可能有助于赋予民主党人设定参议院审判规则的权力，但宪法为定罪和可能罢免职务设置了极高的门槛。

sentences.en: As many as 17 Republican senators would have to join Democrats to convict the president.
sentences.zh: 必须有多达17名共和党参议员加入民主党阵营才能给总统定罪。

sentences.en: Now, there's this added layer of complexity here because when he goes on trial, he may not be president anymore.
sentences.zh: 现在，这里又多了一层复杂性，因为当他受审时，他可能已经不再是总统了。

sentences.en: You know, he may be a former president.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他可能已经是一位前总统了。

sentences.en: So removal from office is not an issue.
sentences.zh: 所以罢免职务已经不是问题。

sentences.en: But the Constitution under the impeachment clauses provides for something else, which is if you can win a conviction against an officer, the president or somebody else,
sentences.zh: 但宪法中的弹劾条款规定了另一件事，那就是如果你能对一名官员（总统或其他任何人）定罪，

sentences.en: you can then proceed to have another vote to potentially bar them from ever holding federal office again.
sentences.zh: 你接下来就可以进行另一次投票，以潜在地剥夺他们再次担任联邦公职的资格。

sentences.en: And this is something that is very attractive, potentially, to Republicans and Democrats for different reasons.
sentences.zh: 而这对于共和党人和民主党人来说，出于不同的原因，可能都非常有吸引力。

sentences.en: The politics of it are exceedingly complicated because you could imagine a scenario where in the short term,
sentences.zh: 这里的政治形势极其复杂，因为你可以想象这样一种情景：在短期内，

sentences.en: many of these Republican officials take that tantalizing option and say, well, we're going to ensure he can't loom over our party, ever win our nomination again,
sentences.zh: 许多共和党官员会接受那个诱人的选项，并表示，好吧，我们将确保他无法再对我们党构成阴影，无法再次赢得我们的提名，

sentences.en: and ever become the president of the United States again.
sentences.zh: 也无法再次成为美利坚合众国的总统。

sentences.en: And we think that's the best thing for the country.
sentences.zh: 我们认为这对国家是最好的。

sentences.en: Well, they then have to turn around and contend with 74 million people who voted for him, some subset of which are uniquely devoted to Donald Trump as a politician.
sentences.zh: 好吧，他们随后不得不转过头去应对那74万投过他票的民众，其中有一部分人对作为政治家的唐纳德·特朗普有着独特的忠诚。

sentences.en: So there may be political consequences for them in terms of losing their seats next time they're in front of those voters.
sentences.zh: 因此，就他们下次面对这些选民时失去席位而言，这可能会给他们带来政治后果。

sentences.en: There may be practical or immediate consequences in igniting more violence or a significant backlash, not just against Republicans,
sentences.zh: 这可能会引发更多的暴力或剧烈的反弹，不仅针对共和党人，

sentences.en: but against Congress again, against the government.
sentences.zh: 而且再次针对国会、针对政府，从而产生实际的或直接的后果。

sentences.en: I mean, it could unlock a series of kind of unintended consequences that I don't think anybody can fully fathom from where we're sitting.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这可能会引发一系列无法预料的后果，我认为在我们现在的立场上，没有人能完全参透。

sentences.en: Now, on the other hand, if they were to think about this and not take the action, they potentially, you know, leave Trump basically on the playing field
sentences.zh: 另一方面，如果他们考虑这一点却不采取行动，他们可能会，你知道的，基本上让特朗普留在竞技场上，

sentences.en: to rebuild himself and his brand and potentially continue to dominate the Republican Party and American politics and lock in place a dynamic that gave rise to this violence
sentences.zh: 去重建他自己和他的品牌，并有可能继续主导共和党和美国政治，从而锁定导致这种暴力以及国家极其严重的分裂氛围的动态。

sentences.en: and the extreme atmosphere of division in the country.
sentences.zh: 国家极其严重的分裂氛围。

sentences.en: So I think Democrats don't know how it's going to end up.
sentences.zh: 所以我想民主党人也不知道它将如何收场。

sentences.en: They don't know if Republicans in the Senate are going to join them or not.
sentences.zh: 他们不知道参议院的共和党人是否会加入他们。

sentences.en: Many are fuming, but it's a complex political question.
sentences.zh: 许多人气愤填膺，但这确实是一个复杂的政治问题。

sentences.en: And so I think they're basically resigning themselves to say, look, we can control our part of this.
sentences.zh: 因此，我认为他们基本上是在说服自己：看吧，我们可以控制我们负责的部分。

sentences.en: We can make the charge.
sentences.zh: 我们可以提出指控。

sentences.en: And what happens in the Senate trial happens in the Senate trial.
sentences.zh: 至于参议院审判中发生什么，那就顺其自然吧。

sentences.en: But the president will go down in history forever as twice impeached.
sentences.zh: 但这位总统将永远作为“被两度弹劾”的总统载入史册。

sentences.en: And that's the best we can control at the moment.
sentences.zh: 这是目前我们所能控制的最好的结果。

sentences.en: And we'll worry about the rest of it down the line.
sentences.zh: 至于剩下的事情，以后再去操心吧。

sentences.en: I keep thinking back to the last impeachment when a single Republican senator voted to convict Trump.
sentences.zh: 我不禁回想起上一次弹劾时，只有一位共和党参议员投票裁定特朗普有罪。

sentences.en: And another Republican, Susan Collins, at the time famously justified her decision not to convict the president, not to remove him from the office of president
sentences.zh: 当时另一位共和党人苏珊·柯林斯曾有一句名言，为自己决定不对总统定罪、不将其罢免职务进行了辩护，

sentences.en: by arguing that Trump had learned his lesson from that episode and understood what was acceptable presidential conduct.
sentences.zh: 其理由是特朗普已经从那次事件中吸取了教训，懂得了什么是可以接受的总统行为。

sentences.en: But here we are.
sentences.zh: 但我们现在却看到了这一幕。

sentences.en: And Trump now faces impeachment again for this incredibly grave conduct.
sentences.zh: 特朗普现在因为这种极其严重的行径再次面临弹劾。

sentences.en: And is that weighing on these Republicans in Congress, the road not taken back then, what it has led to now, which amounted essentially to a threat to their own lives?
sentences.zh: 国会的这些共和党人是否在权衡当年的那条路没有选，从而导致了现在的结果，这本质上构成了对他们自己生命的威胁？

sentences.en: I think the question is whether or not they think about it in those terms or whether they get blinded by the remarkably different circumstances of these two impeachments.
sentences.zh: 我认为问题在于，他们是否会从这些角度去思考，还是会被这两次弹劾截然不同的环境所蒙蔽。

sentences.en: The last was at the beginning of an election year.
sentences.zh: 上次是在选举年之初。

sentences.en: They were able to say, and I think many of them legitimately believed, we can leave this to the voters to decide.
sentences.zh: 他们能够说——而且我认为他们中的许多人确实坚信这一点——我们可以把这留给选民去决定。

sentences.en: This is ultimately a case about President Trump's character and conduct.
sentences.zh: 这终究是一个关于特朗普总统品格和行径的案件。

sentences.en: That's what you let voters decide.
sentences.zh: 这才是你应该让选民去决定的事情。

sentences.en: And that gave them justification not to try and remove him from office.
sentences.zh: 这为他们不试图将他罢免职务提供了正当理由。

sentences.en: In this case, you have kind of like the converse situation where they can say, well, he's on his way out of office.
sentences.zh: 而在这次事件中，情况恰好相反，他们可以说，好吧，他就要离任了。

sentences.en: Why should we be spending time trying to bury him further?
sentences.zh: 我们为什么要把时间花在试图进一步将他彻底打倒上？

sentences.en: Why don't we move, you know, immediately instead of a trial that could be, you know, more inflammatory, why don't we move to try and put on a good model
sentences.zh: 我们为什么不立即行动——而不是进行一场可能会更加煽动情绪的审判，为什么我们不采取行动树立一个好榜样，

sentences.en: and work with Joe Biden and work to move the country forward?
sentences.zh: 与乔·拜登合作，努力推动国家向前发展？

sentences.en: You know, I find myself asking similar questions, wanting to press Republicans to account for their views of him over time.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我发现自己也在问类似的问题，想要追究共和党人对他的长期看法的责任。

sentences.en: And it's often a frustrating experience.
sentences.zh: 这通常是一种令人沮丧的经历。

sentences.en: I think those who have come out in recent days,
sentences.zh: 我认为那些在最近几天公开表态的共和党人，

sentences.en: Republicans, and called for him to resign, you know, seem,
sentences.zh: 那些呼吁他辞职的共和党人，你知道，看起来，

sentences.en: they're either constant critics of him or seem unwilling to fully, you know, reckon with their earlier positions.
sentences.zh: 他们要么是一直以来对他的批评者，要么似乎不愿意彻底正视他们先前的立场。

sentences.en: So what you see over these next few weeks from Republicans in Congress may not look like logical or linear thinking.
sentences.zh: 因此，在未来几周里，你从国会共和党人身上看到的可能并不符合逻辑或线性思维。

sentences.en: I mean, I spoke last week, you know, when we talked, Michael, about that brief moment after the Capitol was under siege and had been reclaimed,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，上周我曾说过，你知道的，当我们交谈时，迈克尔，谈到国会大厦被围攻后又被收复的那短暂时刻，

sentences.en: where senators came together and locked arms to certify Biden's victory.
sentences.zh: 参议员们聚在一起，手挽着手来确认拜登的胜利。

sentences.en: The United States Senate will not be intimidated.
sentences.zh: 美利坚合众国参议院绝不会被吓倒。

sentences.en: We will not be kept out of this chamber by thugs, mobs, or threats.
sentences.zh: 我们绝不会被暴徒、暴民或威胁挡在这个议事厅之外。

sentences.en: They gave stirring speeches on the floor of the Senate and talked about the need to pull together.
sentences.zh: 他们在参议院大厅发表了慷慨激昂的演讲，并谈到了团结一致的必要性。

sentences.en: You talk about interesting times.
sentences.zh: 你真是生逢乱世啊。

sentences.en: I associate myself with Rand Paul.
sentences.zh: 我完全赞同兰德·保罗的观点。

sentences.en: How many times will you hear that?
sentences.zh: 你听过多少次这种话？

sentences.en: The mob has done something nobody else could do to get me and Rand to agree.
sentences.zh: 这帮暴徒做了一件其他任何人都做不到的事，竟然让我和兰德达成了一致。

sentences.en: Rand is right.
sentences.zh: 兰德是对的。

sentences.en: If you're a conservative, this is the most offensive concept in the world that a single person could disenfranchise
sentences.zh: 如果你是一个保守派，单凭一个人就能剥夺

sentences.en: 155 million people.
sentences.zh: 1.55亿人的选举权，这在世界上绝对是最令人愤慨的概念。

sentences.en: And here we are, not even a week later.
sentences.zh: 而我们现在就在这里，甚至还不到一个星期之后。

sentences.en: But now tonight,
sentences.zh: 但就在今天晚上，

sentences.en: I'm calling on President-elect Biden to pick up the phone and call Nancy Pelosi and the squad to end the second impeachment.
sentences.zh: 我呼吁当选总统拜登拿起电话，给南希·佩洛西和“小分队”打电话，以结束第二次弹劾。

sentences.en: And that's already started to disappear.
sentences.zh: 而这种声音已经开始消失了。

sentences.en: Republicans obviously are saying, you know, Democrats are just out for retribution and let's forget about it and try and forget about Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 共和党人显然在说，你知道的，民主党人只是在寻求报复，让我们忘掉这一切，试着忘掉唐纳德·特朗普吧。

sentences.en: President Trump gave a statement last night that was helpful.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统昨晚发表了一份很有帮助的声明。

sentences.en: It hit the mark.
sentences.zh: 切中要害。

sentences.en: He wants to move on to a peaceful transfer of power.
sentences.zh: 他希望过渡到和平的权力交接。

sentences.en: He wants this to end.
sentences.zh: 他希望这一切结束。

sentences.en: Democrats would say, well, it's because Republicans are now closing their mouths and reneging on their promise.
sentences.zh: 民主党人会说，那是因为共和党人现在闭口不谈、背弃了他们的承诺。

sentences.en: And the only way for us to heal is to hold those who are accountable accountable.
sentences.zh: 而我们实现疗愈的唯一途径，就是追究那些应当负责之人的责任。

sentences.en: And we do that together.
sentences.zh: 我们齐心协力做到这一点。

sentences.en: And that's how we move on.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们继续前进的方式。

sentences.en: And perhaps this is one of Trump's parting gift from his first term is that it certainly feels like the country is doomed to keep living and fighting out this divide
sentences.zh: 也许这是特朗普从他第一任期留下的临别赠礼之一，那就是它确实让人感觉这个国家注定要在未来几个月甚至几年里，

sentences.en: for months and maybe years to come.
sentences.zh: 继续生活在并争斗于这种分裂之中。

sentences.en: Thank you, Nick.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，尼克。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Good to be back.
sentences.zh: 很高兴再次来到这里。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: The Times reports that in the days since the riot at the Capitol, federal and local authorities have arrested almost 100 people who they say were involved in the attack.
sentences.zh: 据《时报》报道，自从国会大厦骚乱发生以来的几天里，联邦和地方当局已经逮捕了近100名他们认为参与了袭击的人。

sentences.en: Among those arrested so far were 60-year-old Richard Barnett of Gravette, Arkansas, who was photographed sitting with his feet on a desk in House Speaker Nancy Pelosi's office,
sentences.zh: 在迄今为止被捕的人中，包括来自阿肯色州格拉维特的60岁居民理查德·巴内特，他曾被拍到把脚搭在众议院议长南希·佩洛西办公室的办公桌上，

sentences.en: and 36-year-old Adam Johnson of Parrish, Florida, who was photographed waving as he carried one of Pelosi's lecterns across the Capitol rotunda.
sentences.zh: 以及来自佛罗里达州帕里的36岁居民亚当·约翰逊，他被拍到扛着佩洛西的一个演讲台穿过国会大厦圆形大厅时向人们挥手致意。

sentences.en: We have a photograph of our client in a building, unauthorized to be there with what appears to be a podium or a lectern.
sentences.zh: 我们有一张照片显示我们的当事人在一栋大楼里，无权逗留，且手里拿着貌似讲台或演讲桌的东西。

sentences.en: On Monday night, a lawyer for Johnson was asked about the evidence against him.
sentences.zh: 周一晚上，约翰逊的一名律师被问及针对他的证据。

sentences.en: Obviously, that presents problems for you as a defense attorney in that you have your client in the building at the time of the break-in.
sentences.zh: 很显然，作为辩护律师，这给你带来了麻烦，因为你的当事人在闯入发生时就在大楼里。

sentences.en: Yeah, I don't know how to else explain that, but yeah, that would be a problem.
sentences.zh: 是的，我不知道还能怎么解释，但没错，这确实是个问题。

sentences.en: I'm not a magician either.
sentences.zh: 我也不是魔术师。

sentences.en: And the political fallout for congressional Republicans intensified on Monday when several of the country's largest companies said they would suspend campaign donations
sentences.zh: 而周一，随着美国多家大公司表示将暂停竞选捐款，国会共和党人面临的政治余波进一步加剧

sentences.en: to lawmakers who objected to certifying Joe Biden's win in the Electoral College, citing the assault on the Capitol.
sentences.zh: 捐款对象是那些反对认证乔·拜登在选举人团中获胜的议员，他们给出的理由是国会山遭遇了袭击。

sentences.en: AT&T, Morgan Stanley,
sentences.zh: 美国电话电报公司、摩根士丹利、

sentences.en: Marriott, and Dow, among others, said that their political action committees would stop contributing to those congressmen and senators immediately.
sentences.zh: 万豪和陶氏等公司表示，其政治行动委员会将立即停止向这些国会众议员和参议员提供捐款。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由

sentences.en: Nina Potok and Jessica Chung.
sentences.zh: 尼娜·波托克和杰西卡·钟制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Lisa Tobin and engineered by David Crackles.
sentences.zh: 由丽莎·托宾剪辑，大卫·克拉克尔斯负责音频工程。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是今天的《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine until this summer
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运转，直到今年夏天

sentences.en: when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了许多自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党便陷入了一场激烈、混乱、有时又令人兴奋的权力之争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在我主持的最新一期《都市》节目中，我是萨拉·凯尼格，讲述了那些试图维持影响力却在过程中失控的人的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。

sentences.en: and by the way.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下。

sentences.en: You're in the your shows.
sentences.zh: 你在你的节目里。

sentences.en: and your friends, always.
sentences.zh: 还有你的朋友们，永远。

sentences.en: to your friends.
sentences.zh: 给你的朋友们。
